page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top; page number top left; catchword-like "Cap." at lower right is a catchword below the last line.

main_text.p: men legitur 3 plurali, interfecti sunt; sed á πέφαμμαι interfectus sum, ex φάω occido.

Ionicé 3 pluralis fit á 3 singulari, interposito α brevi, versaq; figurativa κ & π in χ & φ: & σ in δ, aliquando in θ: & longa vocali præcedente versa in brevem: ex diphthongo autem, altera vocali subtracta: ut
Deest hæc persona Ionica in puris quæ assumunt σ: ut ἠκούσμαι auditus sum, ἠκουσμένοι εἰσί.

page.notes: Greek forms are printed in a small, worn type and several accents are doubtful; the Greek transcription is best checked against the scan. The catchword "Cap." is at the lower right.
